LanguageData.RMush_RawLibertyCap.label: liberty cap
LanguageData.RMush_RawLibertyCap.description: A small mushroom with a pointed cap and psychoactive effects. Can be eaten directly or used in ordinary meals. Counts as fungus. Psychoactive mushroom mood bonuses do not stack with each other. Amount affects mood and duration; new episodes are scheduled for 6–24 hours. Repeated intake cannot extend an episode beyond 24 hours from first exposure. Sleep or incapacitation can end wandering early.
